summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Landvision Inc. (BVI) for 30,000,000 new ordinary shares valued at US$240 million (US$8.00 per share). The Consideration Shares will represent ~87.72% of the enlarged share capital. The acquisition diversifies MKDWELL beyond automotive electronics into AI-enabled smart-home/IoT. Certain vendors agreed to a 24-month lock-up; registration rights for resale on Form F-1 will be sought. Completion is subject to regulatory approvals, customary conditions, and Nasdaq compliance. Post-close, CEO Ming-Chia Huang will retain de facto control via an acting-in-concert arrangement. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and potential dilution-related volatility.
